type: m=FUSE; ok() { if grep -qxF -- "$1"; then echo $m:$2:PASS; else echo $m:$2:FAIL; fi; }; chk() { if [ "$2" = "$3" ]; then echo $m:$1:PASS; else echo $m:$1:FAIL:$2; fi; }
memfuse & sleep 2; ls /mnt | ok mem mounted
echo hello fuse > /mnt/mem/hello.txt; cat /mnt/mem/hello.txt | ok 'hello fuse' echo; ls /mnt/mem | ok hello.txt ls; stat -c %s /mnt/mem/hello.txt | ok 11 size
seq 1 70000 > /tmp/big; cp /tmp/big /mnt/mem/big; cmp /tmp/big /mnt/mem/big; chk cpin $? 0; cp /mnt/mem/big /tmp/back; cmp /tmp/big /tmp/back; chk cpout $? 0
mkdir /mnt/mem/d && mv /mnt/mem/big /mnt/mem/d/moved; ls /mnt/mem/d | ok moved rename; cmp /tmp/big /mnt/mem/d/moved; chk renamed $? 0
echo more >> /mnt/mem/hello.txt; tail -n1 /mnt/mem/hello.txt | ok more append; rm /mnt/mem/d/moved; rmdir /mnt/mem/d; ls /mnt/mem | ok hello.txt remove
ls -la /mnt/mem; stat -f -c %b /mnt/mem | ok 8192 statfs; touch /mnt/mem/hello.txt; chk touch $? 0
kill $!; sleep 1; cat /mnt/mem/hello.txt 2>/dev/null; chk dead $? 1; sleep 6; ls /mnt | wc -l | ok 0 reaped
memfuse & sleep 2; ls /mnt/mem | wc -l | ok 0 remount; echo again > /mnt/mem/x; cat /mnt/mem/x | ok again remounted
